한 줄에 하나씩, 최대 32개 · 각 1–40자. 비워 두면 호출 이름과: One per line, up to 32 phrases of 1–40 characters. Leave empty to use the assistant's name and trained pronunciations. A nonempty list replaces those wake phrases; clear it to use the name training again. Choose Save settings to apply.
듣기 시작·중지 선택을 기억합니다. 답변을 읽거나 다른 앱이 마이크를 쓰: Remember your choice to start or stop listening. Temporary pauses during replies or another app's microphone use are not saved. On a new installation or without a saved state, start listening manually.

통화·녹음이 끝나면 다시 듣습니다. 대기 중에도 단축키나 ‘지금 말하기’: Listening resumes when the call or recording ends. You can still use the shortcut or Talk now for a single command while paused.
자동 · 출력 장치에 맞춰 감지: Automatic · adapt to the output device
끄기 · 버튼이나 단축키로 중지: Off · stop with a button or shortcut
마이크가 켜져 있어야 합니다. 자동은 헤드셋에서는 말을 감지하고, 스피커: The microphone must be on. Automatic mode detects speech with a headset; with speakers, it checks wake/stop phrases and voices louder than the echo. Use the shortcut in hold-to-talk mode.
Pro 계정 연결 후 체크하고 설정을 저장하세요. 휴대폰 명령과 답변은: Link a Pro account, enable this option and save settings. Phone commands and replies pass through Sasarisa servers. The PC app must be running. Actions requiring PC confirmation cannot run from a phone. Stop an active remote request from its phone or with the PC's Stop button.
답변 음량은 비서 목소리에만 적용됩니다. 장치를 연결한 뒤 앱을 다시 열: Reply volume affects only the assistant's voice. Reopen the app after connecting a device to refresh the list.
아래 칸을 누른 뒤 사용할 키 조합을 누르세요. 저장하면 전역 단축키로: Select a field below, then press a key combination. It becomes a global shortcut after saving.
듣기 대기 중에도 작은 표시 유지: Keep a small indicator visible while listening is on standby
인사를 시작하는 말 (한 줄에 하나, 비우면 기본 인사말): Greeting phrases (one per line; leave empty for defaults)
인사말 · {user}는 내 호칭, {assistant}는 비서 이름: Greeting · {user} is your name, {assistant} is the assistant's name
화면 제목과 부제 (비우면 자동): Screen title and subtitle (leave empty for automatic)

인사할 때 열 앱 (여러 개 선택 가능): Apps to open with a greeting (multiple selections allowed)

선택한 브라우저에서 유튜브 로그인 확인: Check YouTube sign-in in the selected browser
자비스가 새로 연 영상 창에서만 재생·정지를 제어합니다. 시간 이동은 브: Playback controls apply only to the video window opened by the assistant. Seek within the browser. Controls stop when the page changes to sign-in or another tab.
App launches and timers run directly; questions go to the selected AI.
물어보고 실행 · 기존 Windows 기본값: Ask before running · previous Windows default
바로 실행과 AI 위임 확인은 대상이 확인된 일반 입력·버튼을 바로 처리: Direct execution and AI-delegation confirmation run ordinary input and buttons immediately when the target is verified. Explicit coding requests open directly; AI-proposed delegation asks first. Sending, posting, deletion and payments have separate confirmation. Quick commands such as apps and timers run directly in every mode.
대상을 확인한 전송·게시·삭제·위임을 추가 확인 없이 실행합니다. 결제와: Run verified sending, posting, deletion and delegation without additional confirmation. Payments and unclear targets still require confirmation; payments cannot run from a phone. Save settings to apply.
기존 Claude 세션의 입력칸에 초안을 보여 주고 20초 안에 ‘네’: Show a draft in an existing Claude session and require yes or Send within 20 seconds. On cancellation or expiry, clear only the unchanged draft inserted by the assistant. New coding windows are reviewed here before opening. Previews remain enabled in free mode; phone requests defer this sending action.
Claude Code · 이 PC의 로그인 사용: Claude Code · use this PC's sign-in
조합 · Codex·Claude·Aside 자동 선택: Combination · choose Codex, Claude or Aside automatically
웹 작업은 Aside, 코딩 질문은 Claude Code, 일반 질문은: Aside handles web tasks, Claude Code handles coding questions, and Codex handles general questions. Quick commands such as apps and timers keep their direct path. Uninstalled tools are skipped; each request uses one AI.
각 도구의 기존 로그인·구독과 사용 한도를 따릅니다. 로그인 오류나 작업: Each tool uses its existing sign-in, subscription and limits. A sign-in error or task failure does not automatically rerun the request with another AI. Execution confirmation remains in place. Aside web tasks must be requested on this PC.
질문과 웹 작업을 Aside 브라우저에 맡깁니다. 앱 실행·타이머 같은: Delegate questions and web tasks to the Aside browser. Quick commands such as apps and timers run here. Aside displays its own permission prompts for web tasks.
연결 확인 시 Aside가 열릴 수 있어요. 새 대화나 웹 작업은 만들지: The connection check may open Aside. It does not create a conversation or web task.
Codex로 답하는 요청에 적용합니다. 조합 모드에서도 Codex가 맡는: Applies to requests handled by Codex, including Codex's part in combination mode. Higher effort may take longer. The app waits up to three minutes; use Stop to cancel. Choose Save settings to apply.
키는 Windows 자격 증명 관리자에 보관됩니다. 연결 시험은 짧은 인: Keys are stored in Windows Credential Manager. A connection test sends a short greeting and may incur provider charges.
“클로드한테 …” 또는 “코덱스한테 …”라고 말하면 내용을 확인한 뒤 이: Ask “tell Claude …” or “tell Codex …” to review the request and open that coding assistant in this folder.
저장한 기억, 여러 동작을 묶은 루틴, AI에게 배운 실행 방법을 확인하: Review and edit saved facts, routines combining several actions, and execution methods learned from AI.
기억·루틴·배운 말 관리: Manage memory, routines and learned actions
끄기 · 이 PC에서만 배우기: Off · learn only on this PC
다 같이 키우기 · 짧은 명령 공유하고 받기: Together · share and receive short commands
설정을 저장하면 적용됩니다. ‘다 같이 키우기’는 앞으로 이 PC에서 A: Applies after saving settings. Together mode sends future short phrases learned by AI on this PC, plus their commands, to the original service (maker.buffm.com). Only phrases made of allowed words for sound, playback and basic app names are shared. Phrases with arbitrary words are excluded. Audio, replies, screens, files, memories, searches, registered apps and phone requests are not sent. A random installation ID is used; account keys are not sent.
공유 명령은 약 하루에 한 번 갱신하고, 직접 배운 말과 기본 명령을 먼: Shared commands refresh about once a day. Local learning and built-in commands take priority. Say no or wrong within 30 seconds after a shared expression runs to exclude it. Turning this off stops communication and use of shared commands; it does not delete items already sent to the server.
Shared learning off · learning stays on this PC.
자주 쓰는 앱을 부르기 쉬운 이름으로 등록하세요. 등록·수정은 즉시 저장: Give frequent apps easy names. Adding and editing an app saves immediately.
가져올 앱의 Windows 경로를 검토한 뒤 적용합니다. 이전 목록은 백: Review Windows paths before applying imported apps. The previous list is backed up; import and restore do not launch apps.
자주 쓰는 이름·전문 용어 (한 줄에 하나): Frequent names and technical terms (one per line)
저장하면 다음 음성 인식부터 단어 힌트로 사용합니다. 인식 결과와 처리: Saved words become hints for the next recognition session. Adjust them while comparing results and processing time.
자동 학습 전 단어 복원: Restore words from before automatic learning
로컬 Whisper가 실시간 인식과 다르게 들은 단어를 세 번 확인하면: Add a word after local Whisper confirms three corrections to live recognition. Learned words become hints the next time listening starts; you can delete them. Off by default. Requires a local Whisper address.
Handy·macOS 사사리사·Windows 단어 JSON 또는 한 줄에: Import Handy, macOS Sasarisa or Windows vocabulary JSON, or TXT with one word per line.
제거할 말버릇 (한 줄에 하나, 단어 전체가 같을 때만): Filler words to remove (one per line; whole-word matches only)
선택한 AI로 받아쓰기 다듬기: Polish dictation with the selected AI
켜면 받아쓴 글과 자주 쓰는 단어를 설정한 AI에 보냅니다. 6초 안에: Send dictated text and vocabulary to the configured AI. If no result arrives within six seconds, only filler words are removed before insertion. Off by default.
받아쓰기 중 ‘줄바꿈·보내’는 Enter, ‘지워·취소·되돌려’는 문서: During dictation, new line and send press Enter; erase, cancel and undo undo the document edit; stop ends dictation. Add enter or send to a sentence to press Enter after inserting it. Enter and multiline input are reviewed before execution.
Test unsaved vocabulary and filler-word settings with the saved AI connection.
Use a dedicated wake detector together with name activation.
호출어를 인식 단서에 포함: Include wake phrases as recognition hints
이름 호출 모드에서 별도 호출어 또는 현재 이름·한글 발음·학습한 발음을: In name mode, add the separate wake phrases or current name, Korean pronunciation and trained pronunciations as hints. Turn this off if unrelated speech triggers a wake phrase.
작게 들리는 목소리는 2~5배부터 조절하세요. 저장하면 이 앱의 인식에만: For quiet voices, try a gain of 2–5. Saving applies it only to this app's recognition. The meter shows the original input level; gain cannot restore a muted microphone or already clipped audio.
NVIDIA·CPU 방식은 엔진을 한 번 설치하면 자비스가 자동 실행합니: Install the NVIDIA or CPU engine once; the assistant starts it automatically. Short, clear commands run directly. If refinement fails, basic recognition continues. Name mode also rechecks short missed wake phrases.
‘직접 실행한 로컬 서버’에서만 사용합니다. 주소가 비어 있으면 보정하지: Used only with a manually started local server. An empty address disables refinement.
저장된 호출·단축키·인사·단어 설정을 내보내거나 복원합니다. API 키·: Export or restore saved wake, shortcut, greeting and vocabulary settings. API keys, sign-ins, memories, routines and registered apps are excluded.
Mac에서 사용한 .macbutler/config.json을 복사해 선택: Copy and select the Mac's .macbutler/config.json. Review conversion notes and changes before applying.
Saved settings apply from the next recognition session.
듣기 시작을 누른 뒤 ‘자비스’라고 부르거나, Ctrl + Shift +: Choose Start listening and say your assistant's name, or press Ctrl + Shift + Space and speak. Typed requests use the same commands.

글을 드래그해 선택한 뒤 “선택한 글 공손하게 다듬어 줘”라고 말하면 원: Select some text and ask to polish the selected text to compare the original and revision before applying.
설정에서 프로젝트 폴더를 선택하고 “클로드한테 이 프로젝트 설명해 달라고: Choose a project folder in Settings, then ask “tell Claude to explain this project”. Review the request to open Claude Code in the selected folder.

로컬·인터넷 모두 적용하며 자비스의 답변 읽기 설정도 함께 바뀝니다. 음: Applies to local and Internet connections and also changes the assistant's read-replies setting. Choose volume and output device in PC settings.
코드는 10분 동안, 연결은 최대 8시간 유효합니다. 초기화하면 모든 휴: Codes last ten minutes; connections last up to eight hours. Reset cancels all phone connections and active phone requests. Connections start disabled after an app restart. Internet commands and replies pass through an HTTPS relay.
인터넷 모드: PC와 폰에서 sasarisa.xsw.kr 접속이 허용되어:
Internet mode: the PC and phone must be able to reach sasarisa.xsw.kr. They do not need the same network or router port forwarding.
Voice input needs browser microphone permission. Use Chrome on Galaxy or Safari on iPhone. Your browser provider's speech recognition service may be used.

Local mode: connect the PC and phone to the same router. If Windows Firewall asks, allow this app on a trusted private network. You do not need to disable the firewall.
This connection uses HTTP, so enable it only on a trusted home or office network. Re-enable the connection if its address changes. You can also dictate with the phone keyboard and send the text.

AI replies use the pricing of the service selected on the PC.
